## Life Expectancy Analysis

Here, I re-examine the analysis of Oeppen and Vaupel (2002).

Use gapminder :: gapminder_unfiltered from tidyverse packages to find the maximum life expectancy for each year and country wich had the maximum life expectancy.

Here is the code to use to organize the data for nanlysis

```{r}
gapminder::gapminder_unfiltered |> group_by(year) |> filter(lifeExp == max(lifeExp)) |> ungroup() |> select(year, country, lifeExp) |> arrange(year) -> sumdat
```

```{r}
gapminder::gapminder_unfiltered

sumdat <- gapminder::gapminder_unfiltered

sumdat |> group_by(year) |> filter(lifeExp == max(lifeExp)) |> ungroup() |> select(year, country, lifeExp) |> arrange(year)
```
